newsitem.title: GERMANY: Arthuis calls for EU "stability council" post-1999.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis calls for EU "stability council" post-1999.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis called after a Franco-German economic summit on Tuesday for the creation of an informal EU "Stability Council" once monetary union started in 1999.

Bank of France Governor Jean Claude Trichet told Reuters Finance Television after the summit new conference the finance ministers of both countries had fully agreed on the need for a stability pact and an EU stability council.

"I think it's very important that we have a good agreement between Germany and France and, of course, all others in Europe in order to ensure the credibility of the ECB (European central bank), the credibility of the euro," Trichet said of the pact.
